sign_texture_boundary.order_N2_assumption: For a normalized state with q0[psi]+gE_nu W_N<=K N^2, both q0[psi]<=K N^2 and E_nu W_N<=K N^2/g
sign_texture_boundary.amplitude_and_shell: K1538 gives E_nu|||phi_N|-A_N||_2^2=O_g(1), while K1539 gives centered shell covariance T_N>=kappa C_N/2=Theta(N^2)
sign_texture_boundary.sign_factorization: With s_phi=sgn(phi_N) and e_phi=|phi_N|-A_N, one has phi_N=A_N s_phi+s_phi e_phi and ||P_N(phi_N-A_Ns_phi)||_2<=||e_phi||_2
sign_texture_boundary.ultraviolet_sign_mass: Because E||P_N phi_N||_2^2>=T_N and E||e_phi||_2^2=O_g(1), the inequality ||x||^2<=2||y||^2+2||x-y||^2 yields E_nu||P_N s_phi||_2^2>=kappa/12+o(1)
sign_texture_boundary.capacity_reduction: An order-N2 upper trial in the fixed beta=1 representation must therefore localize on amplitude-rigid configurations whose spatial sign fields retain a nonvanishing fixed-ratio ultraviolet-shell component. The remaining question is the Gaussian weighted Dirichlet capacity of this sign-texture tube, not the union of two constant wells
sign_texture_boundary.carre_improvement: Writing D_N=phi_N^2-3C_N, projection contraction gives Gamma_Omega(W_N)<=8int D_N^2 phi_N^2=8int(D_N^3+3C_ND_N^2). Since D_N is 2N-bandlimited, ||D_N||_infinity<=cN^(3/2)sqrt(W_N), so Gamma_Omega(W_N)<=c[N^(3/2)W_N^(3/2)+C_NW_N] and is O(N^(9/2)) on W_N=O(N^2)
sign_texture_boundary.scope_guard: Neither the sign-shell condition nor the improved carre-du-champ bound supplies the relative transition-mass estimate needed for an O(N2) bump quotient; no order-N2 trial, superquadratic capacity lower bound or ground-energy asymptotic is proved
